rationale: A huge offset like ':-999999999999999999' made VecDeque::with_capacity panic with capacity overflow. Capping the preallocation at 1024 stops the panic. The logical buffer_size is unchanged, so the buffer still grows on demand and ordinary --line-range behavior is preserved. saturating_add(1) also guards against overflow when the offset is usize::MAX. I did this from source inspection only and did not build or run anything.
